scope: Official evidence for the current PEP primary mathematics textbook architecture aligned to the 2022 curriculum standard.

edition_policy.implementation_wording: PEP states that the 12th series began formal use in starting grades from autumn 2024.
edition_policy.important_caution: Do not assume every Grade 1-6 classroom is using the same volume/edition at the same time. For exact grade-semester mapping, record the textbook edition and verify the individual volume or teacher guide.

confirmed_design_principles.name_cn: 以核心概念和思想方法组织内容
confirmed_design_principles.name_en: Organise content around core concepts and mathematical ideas
confirmed_design_principles.evidence_summary: PEP describes the new series as strengthening structural coherence across domains and using core mathematical concepts and underlying ideas as connecting threads.
confirmed_design_principles.teacher_implication: MathBridge should compare not only topic order but the structural idea linking lessons across grades.

confirmed_design_principles.name_cn: 以计数单位贯穿整数、小数、分数与运算
confirmed_design_principles.name_en: Use counting units as a unifying thread across whole numbers, decimals, fractions and operations
confirmed_design_principles.evidence_summary: PEP explicitly identifies 计数单位 as a through-line for understanding number, comparison and operations.
confirmed_design_principles.teacher_implication: When comparing Chinese and Western approaches, MathBridge should surface the Chinese emphasis on identifying the relevant unit and the number of such units.

confirmed_design_principles.name_cn: 从现实情境到数学抽象
confirmed_design_principles.name_en: Move from realistic contexts toward mathematical abstraction
confirmed_design_principles.evidence_summary: PEP states that new knowledge is commonly introduced through meaningful real-world contexts and then abstracted into mathematical concepts and methods.
confirmed_design_principles.teacher_implication: The Chinese baseline should not be described as purely procedural; current PEP design explicitly incorporates context, exploration and abstraction.

confirmed_design_principles.name_en: Use manipulation, communication, reasoning and exploration
confirmed_design_principles.evidence_summary: PEP describes students discovering new knowledge through exploration, communication, hands-on activity and reasoning rather than only receiving finished procedures.
confirmed_design_principles.teacher_implication: MathBridge comparisons must distinguish the official/current PEP model from stereotyped descriptions of Chinese mathematics teaching.

confirmed_design_principles.name_cn: 分层练习与开放性任务
confirmed_design_principles.name_en: Tier practice and include open/practical tasks
confirmed_design_principles.evidence_summary: PEP describes exercise progression from consolidation to integrated application and extension, with greater use of open and practical tasks and less repetitive procedural practice.
confirmed_design_principles.teacher_implication: Comparisons of practice intensity should separate repetition volume from task variety and cognitive demand.

confirmed_sequence_changes.change_cn: 一年级上册将“5以内数的认识和加、减法”与“6～10的认识和加、减法”调整为连续单元。
confirmed_sequence_changes.change_en: In Grade 1 upper semester, the units on numbers/addition/subtraction within 5 and within 6-10 are arranged consecutively.
confirmed_sequence_changes.why_it_matters: This is direct evidence of deliberate local sequencing to strengthen continuity in early number development.

confirmed_sequence_changes.change_cn: 新版将原先“万以内的加减法（一）”和“万以内的加减法（二）”整合为一个单元。
confirmed_sequence_changes.change_en: The new series combines the former two units on addition and subtraction within 10,000 into one unit.
confirmed_sequence_changes.why_it_matters: PEP presents this as an example of grouping mathematically related content to support analogy and transfer.

confirmed_sequence_changes.change_cn: 新版将“两位数乘两位数”与“三位数乘两位数”整合为一个单元。
confirmed_sequence_changes.change_en: The new series combines two-digit by two-digit and three-digit by two-digit multiplication into one unit.
confirmed_sequence_changes.why_it_matters: The stated rationale is to support analogy, transfer and structural understanding across related multiplication procedures.

confirmed_sequence_changes.change_cn: 高段原有两个“图形的位置”内容在新版中进行了整合。
confirmed_sequence_changes.change_en: Two upper-primary position/coordinate topics from the prior structure are consolidated in the new series.
confirmed_sequence_changes.why_it_matters: This is evidence that the new edition reorganises content to improve coherence rather than simply reproducing the previous sequence.

progression_signals.summary_cn: 几何认识按认知特点螺旋上升：先直观辨认，再从几何角度认识；先定性，再定量。
progression_signals.summary_en: Geometry progresses spirally: intuitive recognition first, then geometric analysis; qualitative study before quantitative study.

progression_signals.summary_cn: 数量关系以分析法和综合法为主线，配合四则运算，由一步问题逐步发展到多步问题。
progression_signals.summary_en: Quantitative relationships develop through analysis/synthesis alongside the four operations, progressing from one-step to multi-step problems.

remaining_research_tasks: Extract the exact table of contents for every currently used Grade 1-6 PEP mathematics volume.
Record edition year/printing and whether each volume belongs to the 12th series aligned to the 2022 standard.
Map each unit and lesson to neutral concept IDs in concept_taxonomy.json.
Capture teacher-guide explanations of representations, key questions, misconceptions and lesson sequence.
Keep legacy-edition mappings separately where schools may still be using older volumes during transition.
